title: How is Magnus Carlsen connected to Bill Cipher?
description:
A world chess final, two presidents, a comedy show for troops and a Gravity Falls film-festival panel link Magnus Carlsen to Bill Cipher.

Magnus Carlsen → Vladimir Putin → Barack Obama → Jon Stewart → Kristen Schaal → Alex Hirsch → Bill Cipher

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Magnus Carlsen → Vladimir Putin: In 2014, Magnus Carlsen lifted the world chess trophy in Sochi while Vladimir Putin applauded beside him.
   Photo by Kremlin.ru, CC BY 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Closing_ceremony_World_Chess_Championship_2014.jpeg
2. Vladimir Putin → Barack Obama: In 2015, Putin met Barack Obama at the United Nations in New York.
   Photo by Пресс-служба Президента России, CC BY 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vladimir_Putin_and_Barack_Obama_(2015-09-29)_01.jpg
3. Barack Obama → Jon Stewart: In 2016, Obama and Michelle joined Jon Stewart at a comedy show for troops near Washington.
   Photo by DoD News Features, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Stewart,_Obamas_(26240104033).jpg
4. Jon Stewart → Kristen Schaal: That same night, Stewart took a bow on stage with comedian Kristen Schaal.
   Photo by A1C Philip Bryant, U.S. Air Force, Public domain (U.S. Air Force): https://www.dvidshub.net/image/2625774/celebration-service-held-jba
5. Kristen Schaal → Alex Hirsch: In 2014, Schaal, the voice of Mabel, posed with Gravity Falls creator Alex Hirsch in Los Angeles.
   Photo by Vincent Sandoval/WireImage (Getty Images 450624820), Fair use (commentary): https://www.gettyimages.com/detail/450624820
6. Alex Hirsch → Bill Cipher: And Hirsch created Bill Cipher and voices him himself.
   Photo by Tessa Bury, CC BY 4.0 / Fair use: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alex_Hirsch_with_Microphone.jpg + https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:The_Book_of_Bill_Cover.png

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#magnuscarlsen #billcipher #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
